description_en: This operation disables an endpoint of a specified type, blocking all subsequent requests from the endpoint and returning an error
description_zh: 本接口用于关闭指定类型接入点。关闭后，所有源自对应接入点的请求都将被拦截并返回错误
name: DisableEndpoint

parameters.help_en:
The type of the endpoint. Valid value:

- **public**: The Internet endpoint. Currently, only public is supported
parameters.help_zh:
接入点类型。取值：

- **public**：表示公网接入点。(目前仅支持public)
parameters.name: endpoint_type
